name: D365 Sales Reports
install: bash .cursor/install.sh; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; command -v codegraph >/dev/null || curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/colbymchenry/codegraph/main/install.sh | sh; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; if [ -d .codegraph ]; then codegraph sync || true; else codegraph init || true; fi

terminals.name: dev-server
terminals.description: Full dispatcher on port 5002 with dev auth bypass: / (v3 home), /legacy (OData webapp), /test (v3 sandbox), /test-next (rebuild preview). No D365/Graph credentials needed; sign in via the dev-login page.
